reviews.review_msg: Very kind professor, the negative comments are confusing because the professor is straightforward and reasonable with his expectations for the midterms. He is approachable and helpful for any questions. Highly recommend

I swear the comments below are trolls. Farouk is an excellent professor and is very knowledgeable contrary to what the comments below says about the topics at hand. He engages with his students well and takes inputs very seriously as he wants to make the experience good for everyone. I hope to see him more after the term.
